description: This file contains unit tests for the SbSocketWaiter synchronization primitive, testing wake-up behavior from different threads and multiple calls.

methods.name: WakeUpEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that calls SbSocketWaiterWakeUp on the given waiter.

methods.name: WakeUpSleepEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that waits on a semaphore, sleeps briefly, then calls SbSocketWaiterWakeUp.

methods.name: Spawn
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing the given entry point with provided context.

methods.name: SpawnJoin
methods.description: Creates and joins a thread executing the given entry point with provided context.
